scope: Authority classification for governance validators across the Nzila OS monorepo. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which gates carry release authority and at which stage.

pr-blocking.description: Must pass on every PR / push to main. Failure fails CI immediately.

release-blocking.description: Must pass before a release/deploy is cut. Failure blocks the release pipeline.

pilot-blocking.description: Must pass for a controlled-pilot deployment to remain safe. Failure blocks pilot promotion. (No gates are registered here yet; UE pilot-safety invariants currently live as contract tests, not as standalone registry gates.)

production-blocking.description: Must pass for FULL production certification. NO gate has achieved this classification yet; production-certification authority is aspirational and tracked via target_classification + promotion_condition only.

advisory.description: Runs and is reported (annotated as a warning) but NEVER fails CI. Signal-only / diagnostic / not-yet-promoted.

deprecated.description: Superseded by a newer gate. Excluded from canonical CI execution; retained for audit replay only. Output is not authoritative.

experimental.description: Doctrine / evidence model not yet sealed. May run only in non-blocking mode. Was 'future_doctrine' in v1.

enforcementSemantics.blocking: Failure fails the workflow at the gate's stage.
enforcementSemantics.report-only: Runs and annotates (::warning::) but never fails the workflow.
enforcementSemantics.excluded: Not executed in canonical CI; retained for audit replay only.

authorityRules: `classification` is the ENFORCED authority. `target_classification` is aspirational ONLY and never changes CI behavior.
A gate may be promoted to a *-blocking classification ONLY via a PR that records stability evidence. Running green is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT for promotion.
A gate whose target is production-blocking but has NOT met its promotion_condition MUST remain classification=advisory.
final:go remains advisory until: zero missing certification artifacts AND full-chain rehearsal pass.
Promoting experimental -> blocking requires: (1) evidence model documented, (2) green run on main for >= 7 days, (3) PR updating this registry.

v1ClassificationMap.blocking: pr-blocking | release-blocking (split by each gate's release stage/scope)

notes: This registry is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which validators carry release authority.
Adding a new validator requires an entry here with explicit classification + scope + criteria.
Phase 5 (2026-06-28) migrated v1 -> v2 taxonomy. It did NOT promote any advisory gate to blocking; it made authority explicit and honest.

validate-runtime-convergence was reclassified deprecated -> advisory after Phase 4 path repair (now runs green via LEGACY doc fallback). It is NOT promoted to blocking and is flagged for re-deprecation once validate-runtime-integrity fully subsumes it.

gates.name: Canonical Truth Coherence
gates.purpose: Enforce coherence of nzila-truth-manifest.json against product catalog and registry.
gates.rationale: Truth manifest is the cross-cutting authority for app status; drift here invalidates downstream gates.
demotionCriteria: Only demote via PR documenting a replacement truth-coherence authority.

gates.name: Source-of-Truth Pointer Authority
gates.purpose: Verify every product/app has an authoritative source-of-truth pointer.
gates.rationale: Prevents orphan truth records and silent authority drift.
demotionCriteria: Only demote via PR documenting a replacement authority.

gates.name: Product Catalog Schema/Invariants
gates.purpose: Schema + invariant checks on governance/portfolio/product-catalog.json.
gates.rationale: Catalog is the canonical product list; malformed entries break inventory sync and registry coherence.
demotionCriteria: Only demote if the catalog ceases to be authoritative.

gates.name: Portfolio Invariants
gates.purpose: Portfolio-level invariants across catalog, registry, capital allocation.
gates.rationale: Portfolio drift produces misleading capital / commercial reports.
demotionCriteria: Only demote via PR documenting a replacement authority.

gates.name: Deployment + Repo Inventory Sync
gates.purpose: Verify deployment-inventory and repo inventory are in sync with workspace state.
gates.rationale: Inventory is the source of truth for app topology, deploy targets, and runtime checks. Drift here was the immediate trigger for PR #497.
demotionCriteria: Only demote if inventory ceases to be authoritative for deploy targets.

gates.name: Single Auth Authority
gates.purpose: Confirm @nzila/platform-auth is the single auth authority; no stray Clerk imports or competing providers.
gates.rationale: Auth authority drift is a security regression class; must block.
demotionCriteria: Never demote without a security-team-approved replacement control.

gates.name: GA-State Evidence
gates.purpose: Validate GA-state declarations against actual deploy/runtime evidence.
gates.rationale: Prevents apps from claiming GA without supporting evidence.
demotionCriteria: Only demote via PR documenting a replacement GA-evidence authority.

gates.name: Evidence Lifecycle Policy
gates.purpose: Enforce freshness/provenance/retention policy on evidence artifacts.
gates.rationale: Stale evidence presented as fresh undermines every downstream report.
demotionCriteria: Only demote via PR documenting a replacement evidence-freshness authority.

gates.name: Migration Safety
gates.purpose: Block destructive/unsafe SQL migrations from reaching staging/prod.
gates.rationale: Data-loss prevention; non-negotiable.
demotionCriteria: Never demote; data-loss prevention is non-negotiable.

gates.name: DB Schema Drift
gates.purpose: Detect schema drift between Drizzle schema and live DB.
gates.rationale: Drift produces 'Failed query' runtime errors (see drizzle memory note).
demotionCriteria: Only demote if schema authority migrates off Drizzle.
knownLimitations: Requires a reachable live DB; runs in release context, not on every PR.

gates.name: Governance Composite Gate
gates.purpose: Composite gate: orchestrates the blocking validators below into a single CI signal.
gates.rationale: Single composite entrypoint for the Governance Gates workflow.
demotionCriteria: Only demote if composite is decomposed into individually-wired gates.

gates.name: Control-Plane Manifest Validation
gates.purpose: Validate control-plane manifests (jobs, schedules, budgets) for required fields.
gates.rationale: Bad control manifests silently disable critical jobs.
demotionCriteria: Only demote if control manifests cease to drive job scheduling.

gates.name: GA Readiness Checklist
gates.purpose: GA readiness checklist runner.
gates.rationale: Top-level entry for governance composite (see validate:governance script).
demotionCriteria: Only demote via PR documenting a replacement GA-readiness authority.

gates.name: Cross-Package Contract Tests
gates.purpose: Cross-package contract assertions (truth manifest coherence, no fake production behavior, evidence chain integrity, etc).
gates.rationale: Contract suite encodes invariants assumed by every other gate.
demotionCriteria: Never demote; contract suite is foundational.

gates.name: Runtime Truth (No Placeholder Evidence)
gates.purpose: Subset of contract tests that guard against fake/placeholder runtime behavior.
gates.rationale: Directly enforces the no-placeholder-evidence invariant.
demotionCriteria: Never demote; no-placeholder-evidence is foundational.

gates.name: App Maturity Enforcement
gates.purpose: Enforce per-app maturity.json invariants and truth-manifest coherence.
gates.rationale: Maturity drift is how UE/flagship overstatement enters the system.
demotionCriteria: Never demote; maturity overstatement is a doctrine-level risk.

gates.name: Governance Runtime Budget
gates.purpose: Track total wall-clock and resource budget for governance jobs.
gates.rationale: Budget signal for SRE; should not block release.
promotionCriteria: Budget thresholds calibrated against >= 30 days of CI duration data.
knownLimitations: Script invokes with --enforce by default, but --enforce is treated as a SOFT signal pending budget calibration (known false-positive risk).

gates.name: Runtime Integrity
gates.purpose: Cross-checks runtime evidence (health-latest, failure matrix) against declared topology.
gates.rationale: Runtime evidence is staging-only and currently bootstrapEvidence:true; treating as blocking would create false negatives.
knownLimitations: bootstrapEvidence:true today; staging-only evidence would yield false negatives if treated as blocking.

gates.name: Runtime Authority Audit
gates.purpose: Audits runtime authority pointers across apps (UE runtime-authority-audit corpus).
gates.rationale: GREEN after Phase 4 path repair (reads canonical docs/categories/products-and-market/union-eyes/runtime-authority-audit). Candidate for future promotion but NOT promoted: a single green run is necessary, not sufficient.
promotionCriteria: Recorded stability evidence (no path drift, no flaky doc-corpus reads) attached to the promotion PR

gates.name: Runtime Convergence
gates.purpose: Convergence checks across runtime declarations (UE runtime-convergence corpus).
gates.rationale: Was deprecated in v1 (superseded by validate-runtime-integrity). Phase 4 repaired its path drift and it now runs GREEN, but ONLY via a LEGACY doc fallback (docs/union-eyes/runtime-convergence is not yet migrated to canonical). Reclassified deprecated -> advisory to keep the green signal visible. NOT promoted to blocking.
promotionCriteria: runtime-convergence docs migrated to canonical tree
validate-runtime-integrity confirmed to NOT yet fully subsume this gate
demotionCriteria: Re-deprecate (advisory -> deprecated) once validate-runtime-integrity fully subsumes runtime-convergence checks.
knownLimitations: Resolves its doc corpus via LEGACY fallback (docs/union-eyes/runtime-convergence); green depends on the legacy tree still existing.
gates.lastVerified: 2026-06-28 — GREEN via legacy fallback (Phase 4; see Phase 4 report)
